correctness.rationale: For the repaired geometric claim, the center calculation forces λ=0 on the reduced square-zero locus, leaving A symplectically skew-adjoint, A²=0 and fA=0. Then U=im A is isotropic and ker A=U⊥. Writing f=ω(w,−), the span U+kw is isotropic and extends to a Lagrangian L; this proves that the single incidence bundle reaches all geometric points, including A=0 and lower ranks. On rank r, recovering im A on maximal-minor charts gives an algebraic inverse. Over the graph-of-a-symmetric-matrix chart on the Grassmannian the bundle is trivial, giving k-rationality and dimension r(r+2). For r=1 the three equations are, up to sign, the 2-by-2 minors of the displayed two-row matrix. Its nonzero columns recover the common line on charts. The resulting line-bundle summands O(−2), O(−1) and the five displayed coefficients give the complete cubic scroll embedding; smoothness of the punctured cone and the five-dimensional tangent space at its vertex follow. No sign argument requires odd characteristic. The removed finite-rank theorem was not false: the two ranks at fixed A are j and j+1 depending on whether f vanishes on ker A; the symmetric-matrix recurrence and independent binary spectrum (1,45,330) agree with it.
residual_risks: The repair makes no assertion about the original nonreduced defining scheme or singular loci above r=1.
The finite regression is not a proof of the geometric claims; the published symbolic argument is what establishes them.

value.rationale: The reduced variety cut out by a natural nilpotence condition on a classical Lie algebra is a motivated object. Its irreducibility across all characteristics rules out separate components at lower quotient ranks; the incidence model explains this and gives a rational chart and exact dimension over the base field. The explicit rank-one scroll description sharpens that result to a concrete singularity model in the smallest dimension. These are usable geometric facts, not a claim of value for the duplicate rank census.
residual_risks: The geometric value does not depend on inferring a resolution of singularities, higher-rank singularity classification, or arithmetic novelty.
